title: GPBLUP: a matrix-free single-step genomic BLUP engine for multi-breed, multi-herd pig genetic evaluation with genomic genetic groups

creators.name: Lee, Deukmin
creators.affiliation: Department of Animal Sciences, Hankyong National University, Republic of Korea

description: GPBLUP is a matrix-free single-step genomic BLUP engine for multi-breed, multi-herd pig genetic evaluation, with APY, an automatic data-driven core size, single-step-consistent reliabilities, and a genomic genetic-group / total-merit correction. This is the compiled release (Linux x86-64 binaries, documentation, and a synthetic demonstration dataset) distributed under the MIT License; the Fortran source is maintained privately.
